newsitem.title: USA: May & Speh Q2 net up slightly on sales gain.
newsitem.headline: May & Speh Q2 net up slightly on sales gain.

text.p: May & Speh Inc said a continued focus on its growth strategy helped earnings and revenues increase in the second quarter ended March 31.

On Thursday, The data management services provider said net income reached $2.42 million, or $0.09 a share, versus $2.37 million, or $0.11, in the same period last year, which had fewer shares outstanding.
Revenues increased to $21.7 million from $19.1 million, May & Speh said.

The company said it experienced higher outsourcing revenues and other components of its direct marketing services, which helped to offset significant reductions in its credit card processing services.
May & Speh shares were off 1/2 Friday at 8.
